question: Can a bounded incident-rate-conditioned reciprocity exponent express the local long-exposure contrast change that every scalar P profile is mathematically unable to represent?
forbidden: call the synthetic exponents measured ILFORD, Kodak, colour-layer, roll or process parameters
fit or tune the profile on photographs or P-unavailable datasets
interpret a scalar exposure-time correction as local contrast formation
render photographs, alter AO6 or open product integration from this capacity test
change the synthetic truth, controls, grid or gates after scoring

branch_rule.pass: retain the bounded local-intensity representation as synthetic capacity and require time-by-intensity controlled measurements before any photographic use
branch_rule.fail: close the representation without parameter or threshold rescue

claim_ceiling: Synthetic capacity and scalar-model limitation for local-intensity reciprocity; not measured film, colour-layer, particular-roll/process, photographic quality or product evidence.
